data.title: First delivery
story: The warehouse courier robot needs a program! Pick up the package 📦 and deliver it to the flag 🏁.
Commands run in order from top to bottom. Tap a command button to insert it.
data.starter:
# The robot faces right. Finish the program!
forward()
forward()
data.solution:
forward()
forward()
pick_up()
forward()
forward()
turn_right()
forward()
forward()
deliver()

explanation: The program runs line by line: move to the package, pick it up, go to the end of the corridor, turn right, then move to the flag and deliver. The order of commands decides the result.
hints: Count the tiles: the package is 2 steps ahead of the robot.
At the end of the corridor, the robot must turn right (downwards) before moving again.
